answer: Each new agent must first dock at a public onboarding wharf and lock a non-transferable jade bond that stays frozen until a randomly assigned peer grove attests a unique work trace for that key. The grove samples prior outputs and rejects any identity whose signing pattern or compute receipt collides with another registrant; a collision slashes every bonded jade share tied to the overlapping key. Because every extra alias needs its own locked jade and its own grove window, a sybil swarm pays in capital and real waiting time, instead of minting free keypairs.
